calculation_handling.description: Transition: Articles 200.15.1, 200.15.5 and 200.15.10 do not prevent a building whose permit application was filed on or before the cut-off date if it complies with 200.15.15.4 and 200.15.15.5.
Defines an application for a building permit as one meeting Article I of Municipal Code Chapter 363.

200.15.15.1(1).explanation: Transition rule: the accessible parking Articles 200.15.1, 200.15.5 and 200.15.10 do not stop a building whose permit application was filed on or before May 26, 2017, as long as it complies with 200.15.15.4 and 200.15.15.5 and any finally approved minor variances.

200.15.15.1(2).explanation: An application for a building permit, for the transition rule above, means one that meets Article I of Chapter 363 of the City of Toronto Municipal Code.
